prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
competitors_mentioned: Costco Tire Center and Discount Tire
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: start with Costco Tire Center and Discount Tire for the best combination of price, selection and reliable installation in Pleasanton. Firestone/Goodyear and reputable independent shops are good alternatives if you want more hands‑on service or same‑day work.

Details and how to choose
- Costco Tire Center (Pleasanton Costco on Stoneridge Dr): excellent prices on many common brands, professional installs, usually includes mounting/balancing, lifetime rotations and flat repair (for members) and good warranty handling. Often the best value if you’re a member.
- Discount Tire (large national chain): big selection, competitive pricing, good customer service, free lifetime rotations/flat repairs at many locations, and quick installs.
- Firestone Complete Auto Care / Goodyear shops: good if you want dealer‑style service, alignments and other vehicle work done at the same time.
- Independent/local tire shops: can be best for specialty tires (performance, run‑flat, all‑terrain) or personalized service. A local shop may be more willing to do road‑force balancing, re‑torque lug nuts, and walk you through options.

What to ask before you book
- Is mounting, balancing, valve stems and disposal included in the quoted price?
- Do they offer lifetime rotations, free flat repairs or road hazard coverage?
- Do they program or check TPMS sensors (if your car has them)?
- Can they do a wheel alignment after installation (recommended if tires are different size/ worn suspension)?
- Do they perform road‑force balancing (useful for high‑performance or vibration issues)?
- Ask whether they re‑torque lug nuts after 50–100 miles.

If you want, tell me:
- your ZIP code (or cross‑streets) and the vehicle make/model,
and I’ll list the nearest specific shops in Pleasanton with links, hours and recent review highlights.
